determinism.method: Each function's digest was produced twice: once under BUILD_ONLY=1 as condition 1's control and once by the uploading run, and both printed the same value, which also equals the order's signed table and the S3 object's own content-sha256 metadata. The live value was then read back from the function itself. The two plans were each generated against the live state and applied from the SAVED planfile, so the applied change is the graded change. BUILD HYGIENE, folded in here because the schema admits only mutant and determinism: The adapter's BUILD_ONLY run printed four WARN lines saying it could not restore tracked files under performance/ from HEAD, because another seat held .git/index.lock in this shared tree. Rather than assume the warning was harmless, git diff HEAD was run over performance/ and narrative/ BESIDE A POSITIVE CONTROL (appending one line to bd_adapter.py made it appear, restoring made it vanish). Observed: Both directories read EQUAL to HEAD and the control discriminated, so the four staged copies were byte-identical to HEAD and nothing was left contaminated. The narrative build printed no such warning.
